parts.text: A student is using a balancing method to determine the weight of a piece of soft modelling clay. The apparatus is shown in Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1 P is a metal cube of weight P = 1.0 N. Q is the piece of soft modelling clay. The student places the cube P so that its weight acts at a distance x from the pivot. He adjusts the position of Q to balance the rule and measures the distance y from the centre of Q to the pivot. He calculates the weight W of Q using the equation W = Px y .

parts.text: (a) On Fig. 2.1 , mark clearly the distance x . [1]
